Brand Desktop PC

Brand PCs are pre-built systems assembled by global manufacturers. While these PCs may cost slightly more than custom builds, they offer extended warranties, consistent performance, and hassle-free setup. Perfect for users who prioritize reliability and don't plan on upgrading soon.

Most Popular PC Brands in Bangladesh

Bangladesh's desktop market is led by brands like Acer, HP, Lenovo, Apple, Asus, Dell, and MSI. These brands are especially popular in office and corporate environments due to their reliability, efficiency, and sleek form factors.

All-in-One PC (AIO)

All-in-One PCs combine the monitor and CPU into one unit for a clutter-free workspace. They are ideal for offices and users seeking minimalism. Although priced higher than standard PCs with similar specs, their design and efficiency make up for the premium.

Mini PC

Mini PCs are compact and lightweight, designed for easy portability. Perfect for tight spaces, these tiny systems from brands like Asus and ZOTAC pack serious performance. TBZ offers Mini PCs starting from just 18,000 BDT.

Customized Desktop PC

A custom PC gives you full control to choose your own components based on budget and performance requirements. From entry-level builds to high-end gaming monsters, TBZ Engineering offers expert advice and assembly for your dream PC.

Gaming Desktop PC

Our Gaming PCs are loaded with high-end GPUs, top-tier CPUs, and RGB aesthetics. Built for esports and heavy gaming, these systems deliver top performance, low latency, and seamless multitasking for all your gaming and creative needs.

Business Desktop PC

Our business PC lineup includes energy-efficient, long-lasting systems for daily productivity. These PCs are ideal for office workloads, providing consistent performance and security over long operational hours.

Home Entertainment PC

Designed for binge-watching, light gaming, and multimedia experiences, our Home Entertainment PCs are great for families. Enjoy immersive sound, crisp visuals, and smooth multitasking.

Key Factors to Consider When Buying a Desktop PC

To ensure the best value for money, consider the following factors:

Performance: The processor plays the most crucial role. Intel excels in clock speed; AMD leads in multi-threading for tasks like editing or rendering.

RAM: Go for DDR5 for future-proofing or DDR4 for better value. More RAM equals better multitasking.

Storage: SSDs are faster than HDDs. M.2 SSDs offer the best performance. Use SSDs for the OS and frequently used software.

Graphics Card: Essential for gaming and graphic design. Choose between integrated or dedicated GPUs based on your needs.

Power Supply (PSU): Choose an 80 Plus certified PSU for stable Power Supply. Trusted brands include Antec, Corsair, and Asus.

Brand Reputation: Reputable brands ensure better build quality, support, and longevity.

Display Quality: Invest in a Full HD or higher resolution monitor. Gamers may prefer 144Hz+ refresh rates.

Personal Preferences: Accessories and features like RGB lighting, wireless connectivity, and design aesthetics can influence the final price.

Purpose: Define your primary use case—gaming, freelancing, office work, etc.—to determine the best configuration.

Upgradeability: Look for expansion slots and extra ports for future upgrades.

Form Factor: Choose based on your space and cooling needs—AIO, Mini, Mid Tower, or Full Tower.

Operating System: Windows is the most popular; MacOS is exclusive to Apple systems.

Budget Desktop PC: Starting from 20,000 BDT. Ideal for web browsing, email, and light productivity.

Mid-range Desktop PC: Ranging from 40,000 to 100,000 BDT. Great for general computing, light gaming, and creative work.

High-End & Gaming PC: Starting at 100,000 BDT and going up to 750,000 BDT+. These systems are ideal for gaming, 3D modeling, animation, and data-heavy workloads.

How Do Gaming Desktop PCs Differ From Regular Desktops? Gaming PCs are built for performance with premium components like RGB-lit cases, better cooling, and ergonomic designs.

Which Processor Is Best For a Desktop PC: Intel or AMD? Intel is ideal for gaming due to higher clock speeds, while AMD offers more cores for multitasking and content creation.

Can I Upgrade My Desktop CPU? Yes, as long as the motherboard supports the new CPU socket.

What Is the Best PC Configuration for Freelancing? A modern CPU, 8GB+ RAM, SSD, and a dedicated GPU make a solid freelancing setup.

data.bottom_description:
Buy the Best All-in-One PC at the Lowest Price in Bangladesh

An all-in-one (AIO) PC is often described as a hybrid of a desktop, tablet, and laptop by tech experts. This unique PC integrates the computer casing and system components—such as the display, processor, motherboard, and other parts—into a single, compact unit. As everything is housed in one unit, it’s called an All-in-One or AIO PC. The first AIO computer, the HP 9830, was introduced by HP in 1972. It featured a hard drive and used the BASIC programming language, marking it as the world’s earliest all-in-one desktop. AIO PCs offer a smaller form factor compared to traditional desktops but come with drawbacks like higher costs, limited performance, and restricted upgrade options.

Why Choose an All-in-One PC?

AIO PCs combine the benefits of laptops and desktops, offering better cable management and mobility than standard desktops while being more versatile than laptops. Here are the key reasons why an AIO PC is an excellent choice for work:

Key Components

Like desktops and laptops, AIO PCs include CPUs, motherboards, power supplies, and storage. Due to space constraints, most AIOs use System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, where components are soldered onto the motherboard. This limits customization, typically to SSDs and RAM, but boosts performance. SoC platforms generate minimal heat, allowing AIO PCs to use slim, efficient cooling fans.

Display

The display is a critical feature of AIO PCs, as it’s the most prominent part. Most AIOs feature screens ranging from 20 to 32 inches, with resolutions of Full HD (1920 x 1080 pixels) or 4K (3840 x 2160 pixels). Some models exceed 4K, like the Apple iMac 27-inch with a 5K Retina display (5120 x 2880 pixels) or the Microsoft Surface Studio with a 28-inch, 4500 x 3000 pixels display. Many AIOs offer touchscreens using capacitive, infrared, sound, or resistive touch technologies. High-end models support styluses, ideal for graphic designers.

Design & Ergonomics

AIO PCs are defined by their sleek form factor, reducing desktop clutter with just one power cable. They typically include slim keyboards and mice, maintaining a minimalist setup. Setup is straightforward—plug in and power on, with minimal assembly or cable confusion. This simplicity makes AIOs great for family use. Ergonomically, AIOs come with built-in stands; some, like the Apple iMac or Asus Zen, use pedestal-style stands, while others, like the HP ProOne, offer adjustable stands for angle customization.

Buy From the Best AIO PC Shop in Bangladesh

Mac Studio: A Compact Powerhouse

The Apple Mac Studio is a portable workstation that packs a punch, resembling a slightly larger version of the iconic Mac Mini. Powered by Apple’s cutting-edge M-series chips, it’s available in two variants: the base model with the M1 Max and the high-end model with the M1 Ultra processor. Whether you’re rendering complex visuals or editing high-resolution videos, the Mac Studio is built to handle it all with ease. Let’s dive into what makes this machine a must-have for professionals in Bangladesh.

Sleek Design, Maximum Efficiency

The Mac Studio’s design is a perfect balance of form and function. Built with an all-aluminum enclosure, it features a “squircle” shape—square with rounded corners, just like the Mac Mini. Though slightly taller than its predecessor, it’s compact enough to slide under an Apple Studio Display or fit neatly on your desk. Its innovative thermal design keeps things cool and quiet, even during intense workloads, thanks to:

Advanced Cooling: Air is pulled in from the bottom and expelled through over 4,000 perforations at the back and bottom, ensuring efficient heat dissipation.

Unified System: The Mac Studio uses a System-on-a-Chip (SoC) architecture, integrating the CPU, RAM, SSD, and cooling into a single, powerful unit.

Tailored Thermal Modules: The M1 Max version sports an aluminum heatsink, while the M1 Ultra model uses larger copper thermal modules for enhanced cooling.

This thoughtful design ensures the Mac Studio remains whisper-quiet, making it ideal for studio environments where focus is key.

Unmatched Performance for Creatives

The Mac Studio’s performance is where it truly shines. Powered by the M1 Max or M1 Ultra processors, it’s a beast for resource-heavy tasks. The M1 Ultra, with its 20-core CPU, up to 64 GPU cores, and 32-core Neural Engine, delivers unparalleled power. Apple’s UltraFusion technology connects two M1 Max chips into a single M1 Ultra, allowing macOS to treat it as one processor—no need for software rewrites. Key performance highlights include:

Media Powerhouse: With two video decode engines and four video encode engines, the Mac Studio breezes through 8K video editing and complex rendering.

Energy Efficiency: The M1 chip’s low power consumption saves up to 1kWh per cycle, making it eco-friendly and cost-effective.

Silent Operation: Even under heavy loads, the Mac Studio remains quiet, letting you focus on your work without distractions.

Whether you’re a graphic designer in Dhaka or a video editor in Khulna, the Mac Studio is your ultimate creative partner.

Versatile Connectivity and Display Options

The Mac Studio is loaded with ports to keep you connected. With a total of 12 I/O ports, it’s ready for any setup:

Back Ports: Four Thunderbolt 4 ports, a 10GB Ethernet port, two USB-A ports, one HDMI port, and a 3.5mm headphone jack with support for high-impedance headphones.

Front Ports: The M1 Max model includes two USB-C ports and an SDXC card slot, while the M1 Ultra model upgrades to two Thunderbolt 4 ports and an SDXC slot.

Built-in Audio: A built-in speaker and headphone jack ensure versatile audio options.

For displays, the Mac Studio pairs perfectly with the Apple Studio 5K Display but also supports any USB-C or Thunderbolt-compatible 4K monitor. Connect up to four 6K Pro Display XDRs and one 4K TV or display for a truly immersive setup. Plus, it works seamlessly with Apple Magic Accessories like keyboards and mice.

data.bottom_description:
Discover Premium Ultrabooks at Affordable Prices in Bangladesh

Ultrabooks are sleek, lightweight laptops that pack a powerful punch. First unveiled by Intel at Computex 2011, these slim subnotebooks were branded as Ultrabooks—a term coined and trademarked by Intel to define a premium category of laptops. What sets ultrabooks apart? They’re not just any slim laptop; they meet strict standards for a thin design, long battery life, high-performance CPUs, and compact screens. Ultrabooks have surged in popularity, outshining regular laptops for their portability and style.

Top Premium Ultrabook Brands

Looking for a top-notch ultrabook? You’ve got plenty of great options from brands like Razer, HP, MSI, ASUS, Lenovo, DELL, Samsung, Huawei, Acer, Microsoft, and Apple. Each offers a blend of cutting-edge tech and sleek design to suit your needs.

Intel’s Ultrabook Standards

Intel has clear rules for what qualifies a slim laptop as a premium ultrabook. These standards focus on both design and performance. To earn the ultrabook badge, a laptop must check at least four of these boxes:

Processor: A Haswell microarchitecture SiP CPU (or better) with a 11.5 or 15 Watt TDP.

Thickness: For 13.3-inch or smaller displays, max thickness is 20 mm; for 14-inch displays, it’s 23 mm; and for larger screens, up to 29 mm.

Battery Life: At least 6 hours of FHD (1920x1080) video playback and 9 hours in idle mode.

Resume Time: Wakes from hibernation in 3 seconds or less.

Storage: Uses an SSD or HDD with a minimum 80 MB/s transfer rate.

Ports: Includes USB 3.0 Type-A or USB Type-C, plus one or more Thunderbolt ports.

Firmware: Supports Intel Management Engine 8.0 or higher.

Security: Features Intel Anti-Theft Technology and Intel Identity Protection Technology.

Ultrabook vs. Regular Laptop

So, what makes an ultrabook stand out from a standard laptop? Let’s break it down:

Design: Ultrabooks are thinner and lighter. A 13.3-inch ultrabook weighs around 4 pounds and measures up to 20 mm thick, while a regular laptop of the same size is bulkier. For 14-inch ultrabooks, the limit is 21 mm (or 23 mm with a touchscreen).

Materials: Ultrabooks boast premium builds with materials like magnesium, aluminum, carbon fiber, or glass. Regular laptops often stick to plastic.

Keyboard: Due to their slim profile, ultrabooks have shallower keyboards, though many modern models still deliver a solid typing experience.

Battery Life: Ultrabooks shine here. Older Ivy Bridge models offer at least 5 hours, while newer Haswell ultrabooks provide 9 hours idle, 6 hours of video, and up to 7 days on standby. Their batteries are often soldered or encased for a slimmer fit.

Tips for Choosing a Premium Ultrabook

Before you buy an ultrabook, keep these factors in mind:

Processor: Go for the latest Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher) for smooth performance.

RAM: Aim for at least 8 GB of low-latency RAM, as most ultrabooks have fixed memory.

Storage: Choose between a high-speed SSD for faster read/write speeds (up to 900 MB/s) or an HDD for larger capacity (500 GB to 7 TB).

Graphics: Integrated GPUs are common, but dedicated graphics can run hot in slim designs.

data.title: Caddy
data.description: Boost comfort and productivity with the Laptop Caddy – a sleek, adjustable stand designed to elevate your laptop workspace.
data.bottom_description:
Top-Quality Laptop Caddies Available in Bangladesh

A laptop caddy is a handy little bracket that lets you securely add an SSD or HDD to your laptop, desktop, or even a server. For laptops, it’s a great way to boost storage by swapping out your old CD/DVD drive for a second hard disk. Desktop users can also use caddies to pack multiple drives into a drive bay, and for servers, they make swapping drives a breeze. At TBZ Engineering, we offer high-quality caddies at budget-friendly prices in Bangladesh, so you can upgrade your storage without breaking the bank.

What to Keep in Mind When Buying a Laptop Caddy

Picking the right caddy for your HDD or SSD can feel overwhelming with so many options out there. But don’t worry—here are a few key things to consider to find the perfect fit for your needs.

Know Your Purpose

First, figure out how you’ll use the caddy. Are you replacing your laptop’s CD drive with extra storage? Adding drives to a desktop or server? Or maybe you want a portable caddy to use externally via USB? There are three main types of caddies: optical bay caddies for laptops, internal caddies for desktops or servers, and external caddies for portable storage.

Compatibility and Protection

Caddies come in different sizes and types to suit various needs. For laptops, optical bay caddies (available in 9.5mm or 12.7mm sizes) are perfect for replacing a CD drive with an HDD or SSD. For desktops or servers, a 3.5-inch internal caddy keeps things secure. If portability is your thing, you can get a caddy to turn a 2.5-inch laptop drive into a fast external storage device via USB. Always double-check that the caddy’s interface (like SATA, eSATA, USB 2.0, USB 3.0, or NVMe) matches your device for smooth performance.

Build Quality and Interface

Most caddies are made from durable materials like magnesium, aluminum alloy, or high-quality plastic, with some featuring anti-scratch coatings for extra durability. Make sure the caddy’s input-output interface is compatible with your device to avoid any hiccups.

Storage Capacity Limits

Every caddy has a storage capacity cap. For example, if a caddy supports up to 6TB, it won’t work with larger drives. Check the specs to ensure it meets your storage needs.

Operating System Support

Make sure the caddy works with your computer’s operating system, like Windows 10 or 11, for the best performance. Compatibility here is key to avoiding any headaches.

Cool Features of Laptop Caddies

Top caddy brands like LaCie, Western Digital, Orico, and SanDisk pack their products with features that make them user-friendly and high-performing. Here’s what to look out for:

Tool-Free Installation

Some caddies let you pop in or swap out drives without any tools, making setup and removal super easy.

Hot-Swapping

For server users especially, hot-swapping is a game-changer. It lets you replace drives without powering down your system, saving time and hassle.

Built-In Cooling

Higher-end caddies come with ventilation or even built-in cooling fans to keep your drives from overheating, ensuring they run smoothly.

Shock Protection

Quality caddies have internal padding to absorb shocks and reduce vibration, protecting your drives during movement.

LED Indicators

LEDs might seem minor, but they’re great for showing real-time status updates on your drive’s activity, so you always know what’s going on.

Why Choose TBZ Engineering for Your Laptop Caddy?

At TBZ Engineering, we make it easy to add a second hard drive to your laptop or desktop at an affordable price. Whether you need an internal caddy for your laptop or an external one to connect to devices like a Smart TV for instant media playback, we’ve got you covered. Our caddies are reliable, budget-friendly, and built to last, making TBZ Engineering a trusted name for laptop and desktop accessories in Bangladesh.

Laptops for Students, Freelancers, and Creators

Notebooks

Full-sized laptops that balance portability and power, notebooks range from budget models to premium gaming and business series.

Ultrabooks

Slim, lightweight, and secure, ultrabooks (a term coined by Intel) offer top-notch portability and performance for users on the go.

MacBooks

Apple’s MacBook Air and MacBook Pro run on macOS with M1, M2, or M1 Max/Pro chips. They’re perfect for design and rendering, with a smooth, secure interface.

Chromebooks

Affordable and cloud-based, Chromebooks run Chrome OS and are great for students or businesses needing simple, secure devices.

Gaming Laptops

Built for gamers, these laptops feature high-speed CPUs, dedicated GPUs, and advanced cooling. They support RGB lighting and gaming accessories for an immersive experience.

Tips for Buying a Laptop

To get the best laptop for your money, consider these key factors:

Processor

The CPU is the heart of your laptop. Core i7, i9, Ultra 7, Ultra 9, or Ryzen 7/9 are great for heavy tasks like editing or programming. Core i5, Ultra 5, or Ryzen 5 offer excellent value, while Core i3 or Ryzen 3 handle everyday work. MacBooks use Apple’s M1, M2, or A16 Bionic chips for stellar performance.

Display

Students do well with 13- or 14-inch screens, while professionals may prefer 15-inch displays for presentations. Gamers and creators should opt for larger screens with at least Full HD (1080p) resolution for crisp visuals.

Material

Plastic casings are lightweight, while aluminum offers durability and better cooling. Choose based on your need for portability and sturdiness.

RAM

Aim for at least 8GB of RAM for smooth multitasking. Budget laptops can work with 4GB, but 16GB or more is ideal for editing, design, or gaming. Look for DDR4 or DDR5 RAM.

Storage

SSDs (120GB to 100TB) are faster than HDDs (120GB to 18TB) and boost boot times. NVMe M.2 SSDs are the fastest. For cost savings, pair a small SSD for the OS with a larger HDD for storage.

Battery

A good laptop should last 3-4 hours under heavy use or up to 6 hours for light tasks. Ultrabooks often offer longer battery life despite their slim design.

Connectivity

Look for WiFi 6E for fast internet, HDMI for external displays, and USB-C or Thunderbolt for device connections. USB 3.1 ports and SD card slots speed up file transfers.

Upgradability

Most laptops allow RAM and storage upgrades. Check for free RAM slots or M.2 ports for NVMe SSDs. GPUs are typically soldered and non-upgradable, so choose wisely at purchase.

The iMac comes in 22-inch, 24-inch, and 27-inch sizes. The 24-inch model boasts a vibrant 4.5K Retina display, perfect for multitasking, streaming movies, or gaming. With 500 nits of brightness and ultra-clear resolution, it’s five times sharper and nearly 70% brighter than many top all-in-one PCs. Plus, True Tone technology adjusts the display’s color and brightness to match your room’s lighting, making everything look natural and easy on the eyes.

Built-In Camera

The iMac’s FaceTime or FaceTime HD camera kicks on automatically for apps like FaceTime or Photo Booth, with a green light to let you know it’s active. It’s perfect for video calls and stays off when you’re done.

Connectivity

With Thunderbolt 3 and USB 4 ports, you get blazing-fast data transfers up to 40Gb/s, plus two USB 3 ports for up to 10Gb/s. These ports also charge your devices like the Magic Mouse, Keyboard, or iPhone. The 24-inch and 27-inch models even include Gigabit Ethernet with four ports and a power adapter.

M3 Chip Power

The M3 chip is a game-changer, featuring an 8-core GPU and 8-core CPU with four performance cores and four efficiency cores. It combines the processor, memory, and graphics into one slim chip, making the iMac super compact yet powerful. The M3 also enhances image quality by reducing noise and balancing exposure for crisp, vibrant visuals.

macOS Sonoma

Paired with the M3, macOS Sonoma brings top-notch efficiency, performance, and security. It offers slick video presentation tools, improved AutoFill, Key Contact Verification, and better gaming performance. The upcoming macOS 14.3 will add collaborative Apple Music playlists with emoji reactions, plus easier access to AppleCare and warranty info.

Immersive Six-Speaker Sound

The iMac’s six-speaker system delivers rich, room-filling audio. Its two pairs of force-canceling woofers create deep, clear bass without any unwanted vibrations, perfect for music, movies, or video calls.

Eco-Friendly Design

Apple’s commitment to the environment shines through with the iMac’s 100% recycled aluminum body and sustainable wood fiber packaging. They’re aiming for 100% renewable energy in manufacturing by 2030.

Memory & Storage

With support for up to 24GB of unified memory and storage options of 1TB or 2TB, the iMac is ready for anything. Need more space? Add an external HDD or opt for the 27-inch model with up to 3TB drive storage or 2TB SSD.

Magic Keyboard & Mouse with Touch ID

The wireless, rechargeable Magic Keyboard and Mouse with Touch ID offer a smooth, comfortable experience. They pair automatically with your iMac and have long-lasting batteries to keep you going.

Who’s the iMac For?

The iMac is a true all-in-one, combining the computer, drives, RAM, and monitor into one sleek package without compromising quality. It’s ideal for a wide range of users, from students to creative professionals.

Perfect for Content Creators & Pros

Video editors, designers, photographers, and filmmakers love the iMac’s power. The M3 chip and up to 24GB of RAM make it a beast for running heavy software like Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Adobe Premiere, or DaVinci Resolve. Whether you’re editing videos, designing websites, or tweaking photos, the iMac delivers smooth performance at high refresh rates, making it a favorite for creative professionals.

Great for Students

Students of all ages can make the most of the iMac’s access to tools like Microsoft 365, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canvas LMS, MATLAB, Mathematica, and Google Workspace. Its high-quality camera, microphone, speakers, and Wi-Fi make it easy to attend online classes, take notes, or work on assignments. With the M3’s power efficiency, you can handle a full day’s work on a single charge.

MacBook Pro

macOS: Simple Yet Powerful

Apple’s macOS is intuitive and seamlessly integrates with your MacBook. Features like Touch ID, Face ID, Find My, and Spotlight make navigation effortless, while Siri helps automate tasks. The App Store offers apps that adapt to your usage, enhancing productivity and creativity.

What is a Conference System?

A conference system is a complete set of audio and video equipment designed to make virtual meetings smooth and effective. It allows participants to hear, see, and speak clearly by transmitting audio, video, text, and presentations in real-time over the internet. The conference microphone system is the heart of this setup, ensuring every voice is heard loud and clear.

Audio Conference Systems

An audio conference system connects multiple participants through electronic communication channels for real-time meetings. Ideal for person-to-person communication, these systems shine in larger settings. Picture a boardroom with 10 experts and 100 attendees discussing a critical issue. A single wireless microphone can lead to chaos, but a conference microphone system ensures everyone is heard clearly, maintaining order and efficiency.

Video Conference Systems

A video conference system enables face-to-face collaboration across distances. By transmitting video, audio, text, and presentations in real-time, it’s perfect for connecting teams in different locations. For example, when 10 experts in various districts need to discuss an urgent matter, a video conference system keeps the meeting organized and productive.

Why Choose a Conference System?

Investing in a conference system for your conference room or meeting space brings numerous benefits:

Save Time: Personal microphones at each seat eliminate delays from passing a single mic. Indicator lights show who’s speaking, helping you locate speakers instantly.

Enhance Meeting Flow: Features like voting, mute, volume control, and speaking time management empower meeting leaders to maintain control and efficiency.

Simultaneous Interpretation: For international conferences, our systems integrate synchronous interpretation technology, ensuring seamless communication in multiple languages.

Professional Aesthetics: Sleek gooseneck microphones or table microphones at each seat elevate the meeting’s professionalism, emphasizing the importance of the discussion.

Why Choose Epson Projectors?

Epson projectors stand out for their quality, performance, and innovation. With options for different resolutions, lumens, and portability, they meet a variety of needs, from home entertainment to professional presentations. Here’s why Epson is the go-to brand:

Resolution for Crisp Visuals

The resolution of an Epson projector determines image sharpness. For business projectors, options range from SVGA (800x600) for basic data to WUXGA (1920x1200) for high-definition content in large venues. Home theater projectors typically offer 720p (1280x720) for budget-friendly setups or 1080p (1920x1080) for stunning clarity, perfect for HDTV and Blu-ray formats.

Lumens for Every Environment

Epson projectors provide a range of lumens to suit different lighting conditions. Lower lumens (3,000–4,000) are ideal for controlled lighting, while mid-range (4,000–5,000) or high lumens (above 5,000) ensure vibrant visuals in brighter rooms or larger screens.

Contrast Ratio for Vivid Details

With Epson’s Vertical Alignment (VA) LCD technology, contrast ratios up to 200,000:1 deliver deep blacks and crystal-clear details, making them perfect for immersive home theater experiences.

3LCD Projection Technology

Unlike 1-chip DLP projectors, Epson uses 3-chip 3LCD technology for superior color brightness and white brightness. This ensures vibrant, accurate colors without the trade-offs of a spinning color wheel, enhancing your viewing experience.

Connectivity Options

Epson projectors come equipped with versatile connectivity options like USB, VGA, HDMI, and DisplayPort. Always check that your chosen model supports your devices for seamless integration.

Interactivity for Dynamic Use

Epson’s interactive projectors turn any surface into an interactive workspace. With short-throw or ultra-short-throw capabilities, they minimize glare and shadows, allowing easy annotation and navigation with interactive pens.

Throw Ratio for Flexible Placement

The throw ratio determines how far a projector needs to be from the screen. Long-throw Epson projectors are great for large rooms, while short-throw and ultra-short-throw projectors reduce shadows and glare, ideal for compact spaces.

Image Adjustment Made Easy

Epson projectors offer hassle-free setup with keystone correction, lens shift, Screen Fit, and Quick Corner for precise image alignment. Optical zoom and horizontal Easy-Slide Image Correction ensure flexibility and perfect visuals every time.

Networking and Control

For remote management, Epson’s Easy MP Network Projector software enables content delivery and control over a network, ideal for professional settings.

Portability for Any Scenario

From standard Epson projectors for fixed setups to lightweight portable projectors for on-the-go presentations, Epson offers versatility. Ultra-short-throw projectors are perfect for tight spaces, ensuring flexibility wherever you are.
